title: RADDE nonviolent sit-in outside the National Assembly, Djibouti-ville
scope: One sit-in described; no national or multi-site scope established.
organizer: Rassemblement pour l’action, la démocratie et le développement écologique (RADDE)
participants_original: FIDH/LDDH say four activists were arrested during the sit-in; that is an arrest count, not the total attendance.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. Four arrests do not establish total attendance or that fewer than 50 people were present.

start_date.summary: Both the June 2022 FIDH/LDDH declaration and the 2023 OFPRA summary place the sit-in in December 2021; neither supplies an exact date.

location.summary: The report places the sit-in before the National Assembly in Djibouti-ville.

organizer.summary: The sit-in is attributed to RADDE activists.

participants.summary: Four activists are reported arrested; no total crowd count is supplied.

end_date.summary: No physical end or continuation into January is documented.

notes: This episode began before the assigned month and is not duplicated in events.json. FIDH/LDDH is one joint declaration; OFPRA cites and retells that declaration, so these are not independent accounts. No physical continuation into January 2022 is documented. The late-January intimidation report concerns a separate development and does not itself extend the sit-in.
